note: Game home (My little café) concept art, 18 Oct 2026. Test folder only.

assets.subject: Sunny garden café, the default skin
assets.details: Front view into a small cosy café, seen from the customer side, 2.5D game scene in portrait orientation. Left wall: a wooden bookshelf full of recipe books with a little lotus plant. Back wall: a large window. Right wall: a chalkboard menu board with simple doodles (no words). Far right: an arched doorway with a round mirror and a coat hook holding a peach apron beside it. Plants hang from the ceiling. The lower third is an EMPTY wooden floor with nothing on it (no counter, no tables, no furniture there), because the game draws its own counter on top. Leave clear empty wall spaces and floor corners for decorations. No people, no animals, no words or letters anywhere. Palette: warm cream walls, honey wood, sage green accents, morning sunlight through the window onto the floor.

assets.subject: a long wooden café service counter seen straight from the front
assets.details: Honey-wood front panel with rounded edges and a cream countertop; a small terracotta stove with a black wok at the right end, a little brass service bell and a small stack of plates at the left end. The counter fills the width of the frame. No people.
